description: Create a project from a prompt and build it. A prompt that asks for a game ("build a game", "make a 3D shooter", "búðu til leik") is built with the Amplify 3D game engine (priced as a 3D game: 60 credits on standard); anything else is a website or web app. engine "none" forces the site/app builder, "babylon" forces the game engine. Spends the signed-in user's credits (depends on `tier`, default standard) and can take a minute or two. Spends credits, so it is two-step: this call returns needs_confirmation with the price and a confirmToken; show the summary to the user, then call confirm_action with the token to run it. Counts against this connection's daily credit cap.

engine.description: babylon: build with the 3D game engine; none: the site/app builder; unset: decided from the prompt

tier.description: Model tier, default standard. fast: a small model, 6 credits a build / 3 a change, apps and games only, simpler results; standard: Claude Sonnet, 21 / 10; best: Claude Opus, 81 / 40, slower.

name: create_project
title: Create project
